subproblem.title: The orthogonal cylinder {z + ιv + ι'w : |v| < s, |w| < h} is open
subproblem.statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ and let ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝ^k → ℝ^{n+k} be linear isometries (ℝ^m = Euclid m) with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v ∈ ℝⁿ and w ∈ ℝ^k, and assume that every x ∈ ℝ^{n+k} can be written x = ιv + ι'w with v ∈ ℝⁿ, w ∈ ℝ^k. Then for every z ∈ ℝ^{n+k} and all real s, h the cylinder C := {x : ∃ v ∈ B_s(0) ⊆ ℝⁿ, ∃ w ∈ B_h(0) ⊆ ℝ^k, x = z + ιv + ι'w} (open balls) is an open subset of ℝ^{n+k}.

3. C = {x : ‖A(x − z)‖ < s} ∩ {x : ‖B(x − z)‖ < h}.
 (⊆) Let x = z + ιv + ι'w with v ∈ B_s(0), w ∈ B_h(0), i.e. ‖v‖ < s and ‖w‖ < h (mem_ball_zero_iff). Then x − z = ιv + ι'w, so by steps 1–2 A(x − z) = v and B(x − z) = w, and both norm bounds hold.

theorem dgid_orthogonal_cylinder_isOpen : ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (s h : ℝ), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → (∀ x : Euclid (n + k), ∃ v : Euclid n, ∃ w : Euclid k, x = ι v + ι' w) → IsOpen {x | ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ∃ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h, x = z + ι v + ι' w} := by
  intro n k ι ι' z s h horth hdec
  set A := ι.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint with hAdef
  set B := ι'.toContinuousLinearMap.adjoint with hBdef
  have hA : ∀ v w, A (ι v + ι' w) = v := by
    intro v w
    apply ext_inner_right ℝ
    intro v'
    rw [hAdef, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left, inner_add_left,
      LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap, LinearIsometry.inner_map_map,
      real_inner_comm (ι v') (ι' w), horth v' w, add_zero]
  have hB : ∀ v w, B (ι v + ι' w) = w := by
    intro v w
    apply ext_inner_right ℝ
    intro w'
    rw [hBdef, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left, inner_add_left,
      LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap, LinearIsometry.inner_map_map, horth v w', zero_add]
  have hset : {x | ∃ v ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s, ∃ w ∈ ball (0 : Euclid k) h, x = z + ι v + ι' w} =
      {x | ‖A (x - z)‖ < s} ∩ {x | ‖B (x - z)‖ < h} := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, w, hw, rfl⟩
      have e : z + ι v + ι' w - z = ι v + ι' w := by abel
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · show ‖A (z + ι v + ι' w - z)‖ < s
        rw [e, hA]; exact mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hv
      · show ‖B (z + ι v + ι' w - z)‖ < h
        rw [e, hB]; exact mem_ball_zero_iff.mp hw
    · rintro ⟨hx1, hx2⟩
      obtain ⟨v, w, hvw⟩ := hdec (x - z)
      have hx1' : ‖A (x - z)‖ < s := hx1
      have hx2' : ‖B (x - z)‖ < h := hx2
      rw [hvw, hA] at hx1'
      rw [hvw, hB] at hx2'
      refine ⟨v, mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr hx1', w, mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr hx2', ?_⟩
      rw [add_assoc, ← hvw]; abel
  rw [hset]
  exact (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const).inter (isOpen_lt (by fun_prop) continuous_const)

Both sets are strict sublevel sets of continuous functions, so C is open.

subproblem.title: Integrality, measurability and local integrability pull back along a parametrization dominated by Hⁿ
subproblem.statement: Let n, P ∈ ℕ, Lⁿ := volume on ℝⁿ = Euclid n, Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^P = Euclid P, let D ⊆ ℝⁿ be open and Φ : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P continuous on D, and assume the domination (MB): ∫⁻_A f(Φ(v)) dLⁿ(v) ≤ ∫⁻_{Φ(A)} f dHⁿ for every Borel A ⊆ D and every Borel f : ℝ^P → [0, ∞]. Let F : ℝ^P → [0, ∞] be Borel with ∫⁻_{Φ(K)} F dHⁿ ≠ ∞ for every compact K ⊆ D, and let g : ℝ^P → ℝ be a.e.-strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞Φ(D) such that for Hⁿ⌞Φ(D)-a.e. x, g(x) is an integer and ‖g(x)‖ₑ ≤ F(x). Then G := g∘Φ is locally integrable on D with respect to Lⁿ, and G(v) is an integer for Lⁿ⌞D-a.e. v.

Let W, S ⊆ ℝ^P with S Borel and Hⁿ((M ∩ W) ∖ S) = 0. Let ξ : ℝ^P → Λₙ(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) and β : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) (Covector (Euclid P) n) be such that β is a.e.-strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞S, ξ(x)(β(x)) = 1 for every x ∈ S, and for Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ S)-a.e. x either ξ_R(x) = ξ(x) or ξ_R(x) = −ξ(x). Then there is g : ℝ^P → ℝ such that (i) g is a.e.-strongly measurable for Hⁿ⌞S; (ii) for Hⁿ⌞S-a.e. x, g(x) is an integer and ‖g(x)‖ₑ ≤ 1_M(x)·θ(x) in [0, ∞]; (iii) for every n-form ω : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) (DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) with tsupport ω ⊆ W, R.action ω = ∫_S g(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) (Bochner integrals).

subproblem.title: The carrier of an integer multiplicity triple lies Hⁿ-a.e. in the support of its weight measure
subproblem.statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P (ℝ^P = Euclid P) and let R = (M, θ, ξ_R) be an integer multiplicity triple in U (R : IMRep U n), so M = R.carrier is a Borel set and θ = R.mult : ℝ^P → ℕ is measurable with θ(x) > 0 for every x ∈ M. Let Hⁿ := μHE[n] and let μ_R := R.measure = θ·(Hⁿ⌞M), i.e. the measure (Hⁿ.restrict M).withDensity (x ↦ θ(x)), with (closed) support spt μ_R = R.measure.support. Then Hⁿ(M ∖ spt μ_R) = 0.

It uses no sibling or uncle declaration; every lemma cited below is in the import closure of GMT.Ch07.Submission (Mathlib 25730c7c, simongmt 2b36630, project b4d606d).
1. Key inequality: Hⁿ(S ∩ M) ≤ μ(S) for every Borel set S ⊆ ℝ^P. Indeed, unfold IMRep.measure. Since S is measurable, withDensity_apply gives μ(S) = ∫⁻_{x ∈ S} θ(x) d(Hⁿ⌞M)(x), and Measure.restrict_restrict (S measurable) rewrites (Hⁿ⌞M)⌞S = Hⁿ⌞(S ∩ M), so μ(S) = ∫⁻_{S∩M} θ dHⁿ. Also Hⁿ(S ∩ M) = ∫⁻_{S∩M} 1 dHⁿ (setLIntegral_one). The set S ∩ M is Borel (M is Borel by R.measurableSet_carrier), and for x ∈ S ∩ M we have 0 < θ(x) by R.mult_pos; as θ(x) is a natural number this gives 1 ≤ θ(x) in [0, ∞] (a cast of 1 ≤ θ(x) in ℕ). Hence setLIntegral_mono' (pointwise on the measurable set S ∩ M) gives ∫⁻_{S∩M} 1 dHⁿ ≤ ∫⁻_{S∩M} θ dHⁿ, i.e. Hⁿ(S ∩ M) ≤ μ(S).
2. The support spt μ is closed (Measure.isClosed_support), so S₀ := (spt μ)ᶜ is open (IsClosed.isOpen_compl) and therefore Borel (IsOpen.measurableSet).
3. ℝ^P is a second countable, hence hereditarily Lindelöf, space, so the complement of the support is μ-null: μ(S₀) = μ((spt μ)ᶜ) = 0 (MeasureTheory.Measure.measure_compl_support).
4. As sets, M ∖ spt μ = S₀ ∩ M, because x ∈ M ∧ x ∉ spt μ ⇔ x ∈ (spt μ)ᶜ ∧ x ∈ M (ext; simp with and_comm). By steps 1–3, Hⁿ(M ∖ spt μ) = Hⁿ(S₀ ∩ M) ≤ μ(S₀) = 0, and a measure value ≤ 0 equals 0 (nonpos_iff_eq_zero). Hence Hⁿ(M ∖ spt μ) = 0. ∎
